name: bst_height_off_by_one
task: BinarySearchTree::height() is off by one for every case: it treats an empty subtree (nullptr) as height 0 instead of -1. As a result, an empty tree reports height 0 instead of -1, and a single-node tree reports height 1 instead of 0. Fix height() so it follows the convention that an empty tree has height -1 and a single-node tree has height 0. Do not change the method's signature.
